criteria.description: Nested objects are redacted recursively (not only top-level keys).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 1. **Recursive objects.** Objects are traversed recursively; nested objects are redacted too.

criteria.description: Arrays are traversed recursively (arrays of objects and nested arrays are redacted).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 2. **Recursive arrays.** Arrays are traversed recursively; object/array elements are redacted too.

criteria.description: Sensitive key matching is case-insensitive (PASSWORD, ApiToken, SECRET).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 3. **Case-insensitive keys.** Sensitive key matching is case-insensitive (`PASSWORD` == `password`).

criteria.description: All four sensitive keys are covered: password, token, apiToken, secret.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 4. **Sensitive keys.** Exactly these four, compared case-insensitively: password, token, apiToken, secret

criteria.description: Primitives and null are preserved (null does not become an object, numbers stay numbers).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 6. **Primitives and null.** Numbers, strings, booleans, `null` and `undefined` are returned unchanged (`null` stays `null`; it must not become an object).

criteria.description: The input value is not mutated by redactSecrets.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 7. **No mutation.** The input value must never be modified.

criteria.description: Public API unchanged: src/redact.js exports redactSecrets taking one argument.
criteria.sourceExcerpt: 保持现有公共 API（函数名与参数不变）
